description:
We are seeking a dedicated SDC/Infection Control Nurse to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital role combines staff development and infection prevention, ensuring the highest standards of care and compliance within our facility. You will play a crucial part in educating our team and safeguarding the health of our residents and staff.

In this dual-focused position, you will be responsible for coordinating and delivering staff education programs, including orientation and ongoing in-service training, to enhance clinical competencies and professional growth. Concurrently, you will lead our infection control initiatives, developing and implementing robust policies, conducting surveillance, and ensuring adherence to all state and federal regulations to prevent and control infections.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Registered Nurse passionate about education and public health to make a significant impact in a supportive and dynamic environment. Join a team committed to excellence in patient care and staff development.
requirements: Proven experience in staff development and education.
Demonstrated experience in infection prevention and control practices.
Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations pertaining to long-term care, staff education, and infection control.
